mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, u.display_name AS user, s.problem_id, p.title AS problem_title, p.slug AS problem_slug, s.language, s.status, s.verdict, s.score, s.total_time_ms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_results r WHERE r.submission_id = s.id AND r.verdict = 'AC') AS passed_cases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_results r WHERE r.submission_id = s.id) AS total_cases, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(s.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finished_at FROM submissions s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN problems p ON p.id = s.problem_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submissions (user_id, problem_id, language, source_code, status, idem_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{problemId}, #{language}, #{source}, 'QUEUED', #{idemKey})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idem_key = #{idemKey}
SELECT source_code FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT compile_output FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT ordinal, verdict, time_ms, memory_kb, stdout, stderr, points FROM test_results WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET status = #{status}, verdict = #{verdict}, score = #{score}, compile_output = #{compileOutput}, total_time_ms = #{totalTimeMs}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'DONE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_results (submission_id, case_id, ordinal, verdict, time_ms, memory_kb, stdout, stderr, points) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{caseId}, #{ordinal}, #{verdict}, #{timeMs}, #{memoryKb}, #{stdout}, #{stderr}, #{points})
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS solved, COALESCE(SUM(best), 0) AS total_ms FROM ( SELECT MIN(total_time_ms) AS best FROM submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND verdict = 'AC' GROUP BY problem_id ) t
